notes: Auburn Avenue ('AUBURN AV.', 60', three pipes) runs down the west side, bowing slightly (west line x 791 at the top to ~990 at the bottom). East of it: McGregor Avenue ('McGREGOR AV.', 60', 4 in. pipe), Albion Place ('ALBION PL.', 35'), Gilman Avenue ('GILMAN AV.', 50'), and at the bottom Earnshaw Avenue ('EARNSHAW AV. (SUPERIOR AV.)', 40'), all T into Auburn from the east. Earnshaw Avenue is opened from Auburn to a closing line at x ~3213 and continues east as '(NOT OPEN)'. 'MITCHELL AV.' (lines y 1631/1736, ~31 ft, pipe; width not printed) comes in from sheet 190 on the west side of Auburn, offset ~200 px south of McGregor, so two T points. Albion Place runs east, curves through a quarter-turn and runs south to a T on Gilman (Gilman continues east to the edge). 'AUBURN CREST AV. (KROUSE)' (40', 6 in. pipe) runs from Helen south to McGregor and ends at both. Helen (printed 'HELEN', 50', 4 in. pipe) is only partly on the sheet: its south line is y ~341-350 and its north side is at the top paper edge; centre taken ~85 px north of the south line, close to the pipe (y ~271). The upper 'EARNSHAW' (no suffix, 50') is a different street from Earnshaw Avenue (Superior); named Earnshaw Street per the no-suffix convention, matching sheet 184's 'EARNSHAW'. A street-like strip with a 3 in. W.P. leaves Auburn's west side at y ~3672-3841; it lines up with the Christ Hospital private drives of sheet 182 (y ~1520-1760 there), so it is not listed. The long vertical line at x ~2500 from McGregor to the bottom is a lot line.
